claims.explanation: The flow starts at i_driveEast_11, which is an input to node_11. From node_11, the event can branch to its own outputs (o_driveEast_11, o_driveLocal_11, o_driveNorth_11) and to internal wires w_drive11201 and w_drive11210. claims.subject: node_01, node_10, node_00
